prompt: Write the blueprint for this request shape: "Go through the folder ~/Documents/Archive and all its subfolders and sort every file into one of these categories: invoices, contracts, personal letters, manuals, other. Give me a report listing each file under its category, and make sure no file is missed."

Write the blueprint for this request shape: "Process my morning inbox: triage each new message since yesterday evening, draft a reply for every message that needs one, and send me a notification listing the rest."
Write the blueprint for this request shape: "Find a free one-hour slot next week that works for both Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor, and propose it to them."
Write the blueprint for this request shape: "Weekly review: list my to-dos due this week, my meetings this week, and the mail I have not answered yet, as one report."
